about: The first bundled pack (ADR 0770 in bar_builds): CC0 recordings from VCSL (github.com/sgossner/VCSL, CC0-1.0). Each entry picks one file by a regular expression over the repo's paths; source-audio.mjs downloads, trims and levels it. Artwork: a 3D render per sound (spec in tools/library/ART.md).
